onboarding.tutorDescription: In 2 minutes we'll show how to create a classroom, invite a student, and schedule the first lesson
onboarding.studentDescription: Want a quick overview of how things work?
onboarding.mobileDescription: Want a quick overview of how things work?

home.title: Home
home.body: This is the dashboard: a summary of the important events and pieces of the app. You can tailor it to yourself.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.body: The shared schedule of all your lessons. It gathers lessons with every student and group.

classrooms.title: Classrooms
classrooms.body: Lessons with students and groups happen here. Materials, files, boards, and notes that should be available to specific students are kept here too.

students.title: Students
students.body: Your students are gathered here. You can invite them or remove them from your space.

materials.title: Materials
materials.body: These are your materials. Create templates here and reuse them later in classrooms. Your file cloud lives here too.

bank.title: Task bank
bank.body: Look up a ready-made task for your subjects and add it to a board or a note.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Issue invoices here and track payments from students.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: The most important events, changes, and reminders arrive in notifications.

sidebar-toggle.title: Navigation panel
sidebar-toggle.body: Collapse or expand the panel with the button at the top to free room for the main work area.

user-menu.title: Profile menu
user-menu.body: This menu opens from your name at the bottom of the panel. Next, each item.

settings-item.title: Settings
settings-item.body: Email, password, and notifications are here. The theme lives inside settings too.

support-item.title: Support
support-item.body: Help includes contacting support, the knowledge base, and starting the hints again.

theme.title: Theme
theme.body: Light and dark theme are switched in Appearance.

classrooms.title: Classrooms
classrooms.body: Every classroom is listed here. We'll open the demo classroom and look through it.

classroom-header.title: Classroom header
classroom-header.body: This is the classroom name, subject, and the lesson button. Your student sees the same classroom.

classroom-lessons.title: Lessons
classroom-lessons.body: Upcoming lessons show up in this block. It is empty for now: a lesson is scheduled at the end of the guide.

classroom-materials.title: Classroom materials
classroom-materials.body: The demo board and note are already here. You can open them from this list.

start-call.title: Start a call
start-call.body: This button starts the classroom video call. Press it to complete the step. There is no student yet, so you can leave the call right away.

classroom-materials.title: Board and note
classroom-materials.body: The demo materials live in the classroom. We'll open the board first, then the note.

board.title: Board
board.body: This is the shared classroom board. Move the pieces, and add new ones from this toolbar.

note.title: Note
note.body: A note holds the lesson plan: headings, lists, and a link to the board.

students.title: Students
students.body: Invitations and the student list live in this section.

invite-action.title: Invitation
invite-action.body: The invitation form opens next. The step counts once an invitation exists.

materials.title: Materials
materials.body: Boards and notes are collected here, not only inside a classroom.

material-action.title: New material
material-action.body: Choose a board or a note. Closing the list without a choice does not count.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.body: All lessons open from here. Next we'll schedule the first one.

lesson-action.title: New lesson
lesson-action.body: Pick a student and a time. The step counts once the lesson appears on the schedule.

classrooms.title: How to join
classrooms.body: The classroom appears after you open your tutor's link in this account.

classrooms.title: Classrooms
classrooms.body: Your classrooms are listed here. We'll open yours now.

classroom-header.title: Classroom
classroom-header.body: This is where lessons with your tutor happen: materials, schedule, and the call.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.body: Lesson dates and times open from this section.

schedule-page.title: Your lessons
schedule-page.body: An empty calendar is fine. Opening the schedule completes this step.

errorPage.notFoundText: The address is incorrect or the page has been deleted

tutor.lockedHint: This classroom is unavailable because the active classroom limit is reached. To set it to Studying, pause another classroom or complete learning there.

student.lockedHint: Your tutor is not running lessons in this classroom right now.
